title: StewardMD Treatment (recommendation object)
description: Treatment recommendations, kept SEPARATE from disease knowledge. Carries parallel recommendations from multiple sources; the engine resolves the default by precedence. Hospital policy is an OPTIONAL overlay (see policy-overlay.schema.json) and never replaces national/international guidance by default.
comment: additionalProperties:true because treatments carry an organically-growing DISPLAY layer on top of the invariant core. The core (id, diseaseId, recommendations[tier/line/drugRefs/evidence], precedence, review) is enforced; display/decision-support blocks are documented below but additive. Known display fields: class, title, decision, antibioticRelevant, references, referenceSources, primarySource, guidelineReference, stewardship, regimens, drugs, investigations, safetyGates, specialSituations, disposition, dstModel, confirm, note, policyNote, outOfScope.

class.description: Mirrors the disease class; drives the stewardship/antibiotic display path.

antibioticRelevant.description: True for infective/stewardship-relevant conditions; gates the antimicrobial stewardship UI.

stewardship.description: Antimicrobial-stewardship display block (infective conditions). coverageMatrix = organism×drug grid; regimens = labelled dose tables; framework = stewardship narrative; toxicityFactors = engine finding-keys.

precedence.description: Default resolution order. Policy = ICMR (default for India) ▸ international guideline ▸ Harrison (fallback when guidelines silent). Hospital overlay is applied on top only when the user selects their hospital.

recommendations.description: Regimen recommendations. MAY be empty for conditions where withholding antimicrobials is the recommendation (e.g. dengue, viral hepatitis/meningitis, URTI) — in that case antibioticRelevant is false and decision.label states antibiotics are not indicated.

line.description: empiric/definitive/alternative/supportive/adjunct for infective regimens; 'management' for non-infective condition management.

steps.description: Ordered management steps (non-drug or staged interventions) for this recommendation.

drugRefs.description: Structured links into the Drug Index by composition (the ONLY pharmacology DB) — never free-text-only, never duplicated drug data.

comboLabel.description: If part of a combination regimen.

regimenLabel.description: Display label for this drug within the regimen.

coverage.description: What this agent covers / when to prefer it.

pathwaysRef.description: Link to a clinical-pathway module id.

source.description: e.g. ICMR, IDSA, ATS/IDSA, KDIGO, ADA, ACC/AHA, ESC, GOLD, GINA, AASLD, EASL, Harrison 22e, 'StewardMD (Harrison/IDSA-aligned)'.

refs.description: Multiple source references (shipped files use this array form alongside/instead of the single 'ref').

docId.description: Id into guidelineDocuments (source-manifest) when the evidence is a specific document.

grade.description: Strength/quality if stated by the guideline.

conflicts.description: Recorded when sources genuinely disagree — keep BOTH, tagged; engine still shows a primary by precedence.

clinicianApproved.description: Explicit clinician sign-off flag. Must be true before AI-drafted/in-review dosing content drives diagnostic display.
